gloss: running the full distance; completing a course

definitions.gloss: running the full distance; covering the entire course
definitions.explanation: Successfully running or traveling the entire length of a route or course. Used for races, road trips, and challenging journeys. Implies endurance and accomplishment.

examples.japanese: フルマラソン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{走破|そうは}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三時間|さんじかん}→三時間：30478_sanjikan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{走破|そうは}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I covered the entire course in three hours.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日本列島|にほんれっとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{縦断|じゅうだん}→縦断：09035_juudan⟧{走破|そうは}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}→挑戦：03495_chousen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧。
examples.english: He succeeded in his challenge to cycle the entire length of the Japanese archipelago.

notes:
Composed of {走|そう} (run) + {破|は} (break through). The {破|は} component conveys the sense of pushing through to completion despite difficulty. Primarily used in sports and travel contexts where completing a long or challenging distance is an achievement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {走破|そうは}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to run/cover the full distance
- ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{走破|そうは}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to complete the entire course
- {走破|そうは}⟦{距離|きょり}→距離：05331_kyori⟧: distance covered
- {走破|そうは}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: completion time
- {走破|そうは}⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧: course completion record

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{完走|かんそう}→完走：16981_kansou⟧: finishing a race — emphasizes completing the race, especially without dropping out
- ⟦{踏破|とうは}→踏破：19804_touha⟧: traversing on foot — used for hiking or walking through difficult terrain
- ⟦{縦断|じゅうだん}→縦断：09035_juudan⟧: traveling the full length — traversing something from end to end (north-south or top-bottom)
